units.source_text: 阿光的心情变得快活了。
但她依然对着梦中的自己回答说：“不过，

en.t: But she still answered the self in her dream, saying, "Still,

units.source_text: 阿樱姐不像我，谁也不会说她像只狐狸精。

en.t: Sister O-Sakura is not like me, and no one would ever say she looks like a fox spirit.

units.source_text: 阿樱姐还说，我跟她不仅长相不一样，性格也不同。”

en.t: Sister O-Sakura also said that she and I are different not only in appearance, but in temperament too."
